description: An elegant wedding invitation stationery set displayed on a wooden table with a lace runner. The suite features deep emerald green and cream-colored cards adorned with intricate gold foil floral patterns, wax seals, an acrylic invitation sign, an open presentation gift box with a drawer, matching envelopes, white roses, loose petals, and a pearl necklace.

key_details.color_scheme: Emerald green, ivory/cream, and metallic gold
key_details.materials: Heavy cardstock, acrylic, gold foil, wax seal, lace fabric
key_details.components: Boxed invitation set with pull-out drawer, floral monogram cards, acrylic plaque, and coordinating response cards
